{{Quote|We're lucky that suicide run on the Dominion only killed two of us.''"<br />"''Very lucky, considering the two Moffs we lost.|Members of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] discussing the battle|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Roche''' took place in [[41 ABY]], as part of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

==The battle==
The [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], was an associate state with a high level of connections to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], and had allied with [[Darth Caedus]]. The Galactic Alliance attempted to capture the [[Roche asteroid field|Roche asteroids]] to use [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] technology for their war effort. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], allied with the Verpine, defended them with the help of Jacen's twin sister, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].

The Remnant employed an aerosol [[nanovirus]] that was made to kill only the soldier caste, but not affecting other creatures or Verpine so they could continue to work in the munitions factories.

The Imperials used the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Dominion (Star Dreadnought)|''Dominion'']] as their flagship during the battle. It was reduced to a flaming hulk by a concentrated starfighter assault from [[Nickel One]].
